summary: First test iteration for DSSE co-working booking portal. Backend: 39/39 pytest tests PASS covering auth, 55 seats, config, teams (CSV import/create), RBAC, user management, 10+ booking rule validations (working hours, lead time, daily/weekly caps, overlap, 7-day window, max hours), booking approval/reject/bulk-approve, dashboard KPIs, violations (tier_1 + tier_3 auto-suspend), guidelines. Frontend: landing, /login, /admin dashboard with KPI cards + 14-day chart, /admin/users, /admin/teams (Lumen/Bharat/Groww seeded), /admin/seats with 55-seat fishbone SVG, /admin/approvals, /admin/configuration, /admin/violations, /admin/guidelines, /signup, and /book member view with date tabs + floor map + timeline toggle all render correctly. Super admin login works and redirects to /admin. Found & fixed 1 critical bug: POST /api/auth/register returned 500 because MongoDB ObjectId was leaking into the response.

minor.issue: (FIXED during this iteration) register response included MongoDB _id causing 500 JSON encode error. Fixed by excluding _id when building user response in server.py.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning on initial mount; chart still renders correctly after size calc. Likely ResponsiveContainer parent has 0 height briefly during first paint. Consider setting explicit min-height on chart container.

action_items: (Optional) set an explicit min-height on the 14-day chart container on /admin to suppress recharts -1 width warning.
(Optional) Admin-created users receive their initial password via a notification (server.py:520). Consider removing plaintext password from notification body for security.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register endpoint leaked MongoDB _id — FIXED.
auth.py cookies use secure=False (OK for HTTP preview but should be True in production).
JWT_SECRET is stored in backend/.env (fine) — confirmed bcrypt hashing ($2b$) used by hash_password.
validate_booking() uses start.hour/end.hour for working hours check which is consistent with 'bookings on the hour' rule.
Daily/weekly cap computation iterates bookings in Python; at scale should consider aggregation pipelines but acceptable for MVP.
No explicit brute force lockout on /api/auth/login (no 5-fail lockout). Acceptable for MVP but flagged per playbook.

CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is not fully spec-compliant; browsers ignore credentials on wildcard. For cookie auth to work in prod, use explicit origin (FRONTEND_URL). Currently frontend also sends Bearer token as fallback so it works.
test_credentials: Super admin ideas.iitb@gmail.com / Admin@123 works. Test member created via admin-create-user flow during tests.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_* prefixed teams, members, applicants, violations, guidelines versions. Not cleaned up (acceptable for dev).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_dsse_backend.py is reusable (idempotent — creates unique timestamped emails and iterates seats/days to avoid collisions). The test that needs stateful order: TestAuth -> TestUserManagement -> TestBookings. A fix was applied to server.py register endpoint. CORS allow_credentials with wildcard is a latent issue for production cookie auth but currently works due to Bearer fallback.
